newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt Q2 96/7 trade deficit narrows by 3.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Egypt Q2 96/7 trade deficit narrows by 3.8 pct.

text.p: Egypt's trade deficit narrowed by 3.8 percent to $2,692.5 million in the second quarter of the 1996/7 financial year from $2,795 million in Q1, the Central Bank said in a bulletin made available on Tuesday.
Exports rose slightly to $1,157.1 million in the second quarter 1996/7 from $1,122.3 million while imports declined fractionally to $3,849.6 million from $3,917.3 million.
The figures showed that the Q2 1996/7 trade deficit had also shrunk by 0.19 percent compared to the same period of the previous financial year.
